name: net-android-debugger
description: Debug .NET for Android apps (C# on MonoVM) through the Mono Soft Debugger.

netAndroidDebugger.adapterPath.markdownDescription: Full path to `NetAndroidDebugger.Dap.dll`. Leave empty to use the folder `register-mcp.cmd` publishes to (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\net-android-debugger` on Windows, `~/.local/share/net-android-debugger` elsewhere).

netAndroidDebugger.dotnetPath.description: The dotnet executable used to run the adapter.

deviceSerial.description: adb serial of the target device, from `adb devices`. Always explicit - there is no default device.

deploy.description: Build and install the app before launching.

configuration.description: msbuild configuration used for the deploy.

basePort.description: First SDB port; every further process of the app takes the next one.

propertyLifetimeSeconds.description: How long the device-side debug property stays valid after launch.

keepPropertyFresh.description: Keep the property valid for the whole session, so processes the app starts much later are debugged too. While it is on, any other Mono app starting on the device stalls waiting for a debugger on our port.

exceptionRules.description: Per-exception rules, in order; the first one that matches decides. The criteria that are set are AND-ed, an unset one matches anything. These rules belong to the app, so they live with the project.

action.description: What to do with an exception this rule matches. Only break suspends the app.

type.description: Exact exception type name, e.g. System.InvalidOperationException.

typeContains.description: Substring of the exception type name.

messageContains.description: Substring of the exception message. Reading a message means running code in the app, so it happens only when a rule asks for it.

messageRegex.description: Regular expression matched against the exception message.

sourceFileContains.description: Substring of the source file the exception was thrown from.

useGlobalExceptionRules.description: Also consult the shared rules file, after the rules given here.

globalExceptionRulesPath.description: The shared rules file, defaulting to the one in your home directory. It is re-read whenever it changes, so a rule can be edited while the app is stopped and govern what happens next.
